entities.summary: Hasan Fakri is a Bangladeshi film lyricist and poet. He won Bangladesh National Film Award for Best Lyrics for the film Banglar Bodhu (1993). He edits a magazine called Parjas. He is the co-president of the cultural organization Ganamukti's music troop.
